title: Safety Fine-Tuning at (Almost) No Cost: A Baseline for Vision Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Detection of harmful content in VLLM training data, specifically identifying 'derogatory comments about specific religions' and 'hateful remarks about specific religions or public figures'. The paper's safety fine-tuning aims to mitigate the generation of such content.
findings: The paper found that the training data for existing Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs) contains harmful content, including derogatory and hateful remarks about religions. A qualitative example showed a model generating a hostile anti-Christmas article when prompted. The study demonstrates that their proposed safety fine-tuning method, VLGuard, significantly reduces the models' tendency to generate such harmful religious content.
